description: This exam certifies CEFR level A2 in Tagalog: you can handle routine everyday tasks and simple, direct exchanges — talking about your work and background, narrating your day, asking for directions, describing symptoms, comparing people and things, making and declining invitations, and telling simple stories about past experiences and future plans. It focuses on the core grammar of the level: the actor/object/locative/benefactive focus system, the three aspects plus kaka-, the modal words (kaya, marunong, puwede, kailangan, dapat, bawal), and the enclitic particles na, pa, lang, din/rin, daw/raw, and naman.

questions.prompt: Ano ang trabaho mo? — Which is a natural answer?
questions.explain: Isa + linker (isa akong nars) or plain 'Nars ako' are the natural ways to state a job.

questions.prompt: Para ___ Marco ang regalong ito. (This gift is for Marco.)
questions.explain: Before a personal name, 'for' is para kay — para always triggers the sa-set, never si.

questions.prompt: Which pronoun completes: 'Sa ___ ba ang bag na ito?' (Is this bag yours?)
questions.explain: After sa, use the sa-form pronoun: sa iyo. Ikaw/ka are ang-forms and mo is the ng-form.

questions.prompt: 'Taga-Cebu ako' means:
questions.explain: Taga- + place gives origin. Living there now would be 'nakatira ako sa Cebu.'

questions.tl: Nagtatrabaho ako sa isang kompanya sa Makati, pero nakatira ako sa Quezon City.
questions.prompt: Which is true of the speaker?
choices: Works in Makati, lives in Quezon City
Works in Quezon City, lives in Makati
Is looking for work in Makati
questions.explain: Nagtatrabaho... sa Makati gives the workplace; nakatira ako sa Quezon City gives the home; pero contrasts them.

questions.prompt: 'Kumain ako ng mansanas' and 'Kinain ko ang mansanas' differ in that...
choices: only the first is past tense
the second focuses the object and implies a specific apple
questions.explain: Same event, different focus: object focus puts ang on the apple, reading it as definite (the apple), and demotes the actor to ko.

questions.prompt: Kinain ___ ang adobo. (I ate the adobo.)
questions.explain: With object-focus verbs the actor takes ng-form: kinain ko. 'Kinain ako' would make you the food.

questions.prompt: Which is the completed form of inumin (to drink something)?
questions.explain: Ininom = drank (it). Iniinom is incompleted, iinumin contemplated, and uminom is actor focus.

questions.prompt: Convert to object focus (the specific novel): 'Bumasa si Miguel ng nobela.'
questions.explain: The actor drops to ni Miguel and the object rises to ang nobela around the object-focus verb binasa.

questions.prompt: Ano ang ___ mo kahapon? (What did you do yesterday?)
questions.explain: Gawin is irregular: completed ginawa. Ano-questions about things use object focus.

questions.tl: Kinain ng pusa ang isda sa mesa.
questions.prompt: What happened?
choices: The cat ate the fish on the table.
The fish ate the cat's food.
I fed the cat some fish.
The cat will eat the fish.
questions.explain: Object-focus kinain: ang isda (the fish) got eaten, ng pusa marks the cat as the eater.

questions.prompt: Which form of magluto means 'will cook'?
questions.explain: Contemplated mag- verbs keep m- with reduplication: magluluto.

questions.prompt: 'Naliligo ako tuwing umaga.' The incompleted aspect is used because...
choices: it happened once in the past
questions.explain: Incompleted covers ongoing AND habitual actions; tuwing umaga (every morning) marks a habit.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'I just ate'?
questions.explain: The recently-completed ka- + reduplication form takes a ng-form doer plus lang: kakakain ko lang.

questions.prompt: Nagsipilyo ako bago ___. (I brushed my teeth before sleeping.)
questions.hint: The verb after bago stays in its basic form.
questions.explain: Bago takes the basic (unaspected) verb form even in past narration: bago matulog.

questions.tl: Una, gumising ako nang maaga. Tapos, naglaba ako. Pagkatapos ng tanghalian, nagwalis ako sa labas.
questions.prompt: What did the speaker do after lunch?
questions.explain: Pagkatapos ng tanghalian (after lunch) is followed by nagwalis ako sa labas — swept outside.

questions.prompt: Which word fits: '___ akong lumangoy' (I know how to swim)?
questions.explain: Skills take marunong + ang-actor + linker. Alam is for facts; kaya would take ko, not ako.

questions.prompt: Hindi ko ___ buhatin ang kahon. Ang bigat! (I can't lift the box.)
questions.explain: Kaya (capacity) takes the ng-form actor: hindi ko kaya(-ng) buhatin.

questions.prompt: You want permission to sit. Which is correct?
questions.explain: Puwede + ang-form actor asks permission: puwede ba akong umupo dito?

questions.prompt: A sign reads 'BAWAL PUMARADA'. It means:
questions.explain: Bawal + basic verb = the action is forbidden: no parking.

questions.prompt: ___ kang tumakbo sa may pool! (Don't run near the pool!)
questions.explain: Negative commands use huwag with a linked pronoun (huwag kang...), never hindi.

questions.prompt: 'Kailangan ko ___ tulong' vs 'Kailangan ko ___ umalis.' Choose the missing pair.
questions.explain: Kailangan + ng + noun (kailangan ko ng tulong) but kailangan + linked ng-actor + verb (kailangan kong umalis).

questions.tl: Dapat kang uminom ng gamot tatlong beses sa isang araw, pagkatapos kumain.
questions.prompt: What is the instruction?
choices: Take medicine three times a day after meals
Drink water three times a day
questions.explain: Tatlong beses sa isang araw = three times a day; pagkatapos kumain = after eating.

questions.prompt: Someone asks 'Kumain ka na ba?' and you haven't eaten yet. You say:
questions.explain: Hindi pa = not yet. Na and pa are mirror twins: already vs still/yet.

questions.prompt: Uulan ___ bukas. (They say it will rain tomorrow.)
questions.explain: Daw/raw marks reported information — 'they say.'

questions.prompt: Where does the particle go? 'I still study at the university.'
questions.explain: Enclitics sit in second position, right after the first full word: nag-aaral pa ako.

questions.prompt: Do you want to come with us?
questions.answer: Gusto mo bang sumama sa amin?
accept: Gusto mo bang sumama sa amin
Gusto mo bang sumama sa amin?
questions.explain: Gusto keeps its ng-form actor (mo) and links to the basic verb: gusto mo bang sumama; sa amin = with us (exclusive).

questions.tl: Gusto ko sanang sumama, kaso may lakad kami ng pamilya ko. Sa susunod na lang, ha?
questions.prompt: What is the speaker doing?
choices: Politely declining and offering a rain check
questions.explain: Gusto ko sana + kaso + excuse + sa susunod na lang is the polite-decline formula.

questions.prompt: 'Pumunta ako sa palengke' vs 'Pinuntahan ko ang palengke.' In the second sentence...
choices: the market is the focused ang-phrase
questions.explain: Puntahan is a locative-focus -an verb: the specific destination takes ang, and the actor drops to ko.

questions.prompt: Make it a polite request with paki-: '___ po ang pinto.' (Please close the door.)
questions.explain: Paki- attaches to the root for polite requests: pakisara ang pinto.

questions.tl: Dumiretso kayo hanggang sa kanto, tapos lumiko kayo sa kanan. Nasa tapat ng simbahan ang botika.
questions.prompt: Where is the pharmacy?
choices: Straight ahead, then right; across from the church
Straight ahead, then left; beside the bank
Across the bridge on the left
questions.explain: Dumiretso hanggang sa kanto, lumiko sa kanan, and nasa tapat ng simbahan places it across from the church.

questions.prompt: My head hurts and I have a fever.
questions.answer: Masakit ang ulo ko at may lagnat ako.
accept: Masakit ang ulo ko at may lagnat ako
Masakit po ang ulo ko at may lagnat po ako
May lagnat ako at masakit ang ulo ko
questions.explain: Masakit ang + body part + ko for pain; may lagnat ako for the symptom you have.

questions.prompt: Which word describes someone currently seated (state, not action)?
questions.explain: Naka- statives describe positions: nakaupo = seated. Umupo is the action 'to sit down.'

questions.prompt: How do you say 'Ben is taller than Carlo'?
choices: Mas matangkad si Ben kaysa kay Carlo.
Matangkad si Ben para kay Carlo.
questions.explain: Comparison: mas + adjective, with kaysa kay before a personal name.

questions.prompt: Si Ana ang ___matalino sa klase. (Ana is the smartest in the class.)
questions.explain: The superlative prefix pinaka- attaches to the adjective: pinakamatalino.

questions.prompt: Mahiyain siya sa opisina, pero madaldal siya sa mga kaibigan niya.
questions.answer: She is shy at the office, but talkative with her friends.
accept: She is shy at the office, but talkative with her friends
He is shy at the office but chatty with his friends
She's shy at the office but talkative around her friends
questions.explain: Mahiyain = shy, madaldal = talkative; pero contrasts the two settings.

questions.prompt: How do you ask 'Have you ever eaten balut?'
choices: Nakakain ka na ba ng balut?
Kakain ka na ba ng balut?
questions.explain: Experience questions use the naka- form plus na ba: nakakain ka na ba.

questions.prompt: ___ bata ako, nakatira kami sa probinsya. (When I was a kid...)
questions.explain: Past time clauses are anchored with noong: noong bata ako. Kapag would be future/habitual.

questions.tl: Hindi ako nakapasok kahapon kasi may lagnat ako. Pero magaling na ako ngayon.
questions.prompt: Why was the speaker absent yesterday?
questions.explain: Kasi may lagnat ako gives the reason: a fever. Hindi nakapasok = wasn't able to go in.

questions.prompt: Nakapunta na ako sa Bohol, pero hindi pa ako nakapunta sa Palawan.
questions.answer: I've been to Bohol, but I haven't been to Palawan yet.
accept: I've been to Bohol, but I haven't been to Palawan yet
I have been to Bohol but I have not been to Palawan yet
I've already been to Bohol but not yet to Palawan
questions.explain: Nakapunta na = have been; hindi pa + nakapunta = not yet been.

questions.prompt: In 'Ibinigay ko ang susi kay Marco', what is focused by ang?
questions.explain: I- verbs like ibigay focus the theme — the thing handed over (ang susi); the receiver takes kay.

questions.prompt: ___ mo ako ng kape, please! (Buy me a coffee!)
questions.explain: The benefactive ibili focuses the person benefited: ibili mo ako ng kape.

questions.prompt: When I have money, I will buy my own house.
questions.answer: Kapag may pera na ako, bibili ako ng sariling bahay.
accept: Kapag may pera na ako, bibili ako ng sariling bahay
Pag may pera na ako, bibili ako ng sariling bahay
Kapag may pera ako, bibili ako ng sariling bahay
questions.explain: Kapag sets the future condition; the main clause takes contemplated bibili; sariling bahay = own house.

questions.prompt: One trip, four sentences. Which one focuses the BENEFICIARY?
choices: Bumili ako ng regalo sa palengke.
Binili ko ang regalo sa palengke.
Ibinili ko si Nanay ng regalo.
questions.explain: Ibinili ko SI NANAY puts Mom, the person the gift was bought for, in the ang-slot — the i- benefactive at work.
